statement: Self-test of a proposed draft. Passing is not certification, adoption, or a security review.

results.title: Agent manifest is served at the well-known path, signed by a published key, and says the draft is not adopted
The REST manifest path serves the same content (same etag)
Action contracts: published list equals the manifest; no action approves or confirms; firm and admin actions are HTTPS-only
OpenAPI 3.1 document and error catalog are served
An unsupported OLIP-Version header is refused with VERSION_UNSUPPORTED
Production build: regulated writes fail closed while no jurisdiction is approved by counsel
Every checked response matched the published schemas (6 responses)
